content.short: Dave is a US consumer banking app known for fee-free cash advances, a spending account, card and budgeting.
content.description: Dave, founded in 2016, is a US consumer banking app best known for small, fee-free cash advances that help members cover expenses before payday and avoid overdraft charges. Alongside its ExtraCash advances, Dave offers a spending account and debit card, automated budgeting that predicts upcoming bills, savings features and a side-gig marketplace to help users earn extra income. It works with a partner bank and targets everyday Americans living paycheck to paycheck who are underserved by traditional banks. By combining short-term liquidity, banking and financial-health tools in one app, Dave competes with other US neobanks focused on affordability.
